message.content:
I’m afraid there isn’t a built‑in way to pull live ticket prices directly into our conversation.  
The travel APIs let us:

* Find nearby airports (`get_nearest_airport_by_city`, `list_all_airports`)  
* Check balances / budgets (`set_budget_limit`, `get_credit_card_balance`)  
* Make bookings once we know the details (`book_flight`)

But they don’t expose a “price quote” endpoint – the actual fares come from the airline’s own systems when you try to reserve seats.  

If you’d like me to look up the closest airports to your chosen locations so you could see what airlines serve them, or help you proceed with a reservation using one of the known cards, just let me know!
